notes: «عيسى يعني ابن يونس» carries an explanatory gloss, left out: the surface is عيسى.
«كلاهما عن سليمان التيمي» meets the two branches; the names from سليمان on are written once as the shared tail.
The report ends in a dangling «ح» after «عن أنس»: no further names, no saying in the text. Read as written.
